source_issues.finding: Protected Mermaid says downhill along gradient while L21/39/42 correctly use negative gradient. Diagram payload must not be silently corrected during translation.
source_issues.translation_handling: Preserved exact Mermaid; Chinese prose preserves negative direction.

source_issues.finding: Ordinary convexity does not guarantee a unique minimizer or even attainment. Constant functions have many minimizers; exp(x) on R has none. GD also needs appropriate differentiability/smoothness and step-size assumptions; f(x)=x² with lr=1 oscillates. Strict convexity would give at most one minimizer, not existence.
source_issues.translation_handling: Original categorical claims retained; no replacement with strictly convex or unstated conditions.

source_issues.finding: Flat in some directions/curved in others is not a saddle definition (x²−y² has both positive and negative curvature). High-dimensional local minima near-global and easy noise/momentum escape require assumptions. Zero-gradient exact saddle with zero optimizer state can remain fixed; the exercise starts off-origin and is deterministic.
source_issues.translation_handling: No silent source repair; not evidence that every optimizer escapes every saddle.

source_issues.finding: Sharp/flat alone does not determine generalization; parameter rescaling/reparameterization can change sharpness while preserving the represented function. SGD-vs-Adam final accuracy is task/configuration dependent.
source_issues.translation_handling: Faithful categorical wording retained, separate source risk.

source_issues.finding: Adam v is second raw moment, not centered variance; L128 parenthetical is magnitude intuition. Dividing by sqrt(v_hat) changes effective learning-rate scaling, but actual update also includes m_hat. Rescaling a constant gradient scales numerator and denominator together, so gradient size alone does not order actual step sizes.
source_issues.translation_handling: Chinese says squared-gradient moving mean and does not introduce variance; source step-size simplification retained.

source_issues.finding: Learning-rate defaults, fastest optimizer, best final accuracy and always-use-schedule statements are heuristics. A deterministic Rosenbrock comparison with different chosen learning rates does not establish universal optimizer rankings or test generalization. Fixed LR can be useful and learning-rate changes alone do not diagnose every unstable/slow run.
source_issues.translation_handling: Original strength retained and explicitly not treated as broad empirical proof.

source_issues.finding: All three methods consume the same deterministic full Rosenbrock gradient with no sample/minibatch draw. SGDMomentum class name does not make the demo stochastic, and it cannot verify noise-induced escape or generalization.
source_issues.translation_handling: No invented minibatch training, dataset, randomness or accuracy evidence.

source_issues.finding: Standard PyTorch optimizer.step does not automatically clip gradients; clip_grad_norm_ is an explicit separate utility. AdamW decouples weight decay from moment estimates; it is distinct from LR scheduling. The snippet only constructs optimizers/scheduler, without a training loop, gradient clipping or scheduler.step.
source_issues.translation_handling: Protected API code and source claim preserved; no claim of actual framework training.

source_issues.finding: N+1 refers to the ambient graph (N weight coordinates plus loss), not an N+1-dimensional parameter space. Two-direction slicing is a two-variable surface normally displayed with loss height; not the full loss landscape.
source_issues.translation_handling: 1 million（百万）,1,000,001 and2D faithfully preserved without dimension reinterpretation.

source_issues.finding: zip silently truncates mismatched parameter/gradient/state lengths. No explicit domain guards for lr/beta/epsilon, finite values or parameter dimensions; inline optimize has no divergence guard and func is unused. Large-LR sweep need not complete5000 finite steps. Runtime and canonical-file differences belong in parent evidence, not a silent code rewrite.
source_issues.translation_handling: No program edits; parent owns isolated runtime/strict/regression checks.
